reviews.body: Makes sense to me @pcbeingused333, but I think moving forward, we should probably start moving the read APIs to use pypaimon's Daft support (via `pypaimon[daft]`) instead of our own custom one, for consolidation. Will create an issue for it

review_comments.body: **Imports break repository rules** `test_get_catalog_options_accepts_options_object` puts two imports inside the function. The repository requires imports at the top of the file, and neither import needs an optional-dependency exception. Move both imports to file level before merging to satisfy this requirement. **Rule Used:** Import statements should be placed at the top of the file rather than inline within functions or methods. ([source](https://app.greptile.com/-/switch-tenant?tenant=daft-oss&next=%2Fcustom-context%3Fmemory%3D430ffc3f-245c-4a7f-8039-aba31c0ed558)) **Learned From** [Eventual-Inc/Daft#5078](https://github.com/Eventual-Inc/Daft/pull/5078) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
